title: Knowledge
subtitle: Searchable answers from your own documents

empty.title: No knowledge bases yet
empty.description: Knowledge bases you create will appear here. Add files or Google Docs so agents can answer from them.

detail.sourcesDescription: Upload files or connect Google Docs. We split them into chunks so agents can search them.
detail.agentsNote: Agents only answer from knowledge bases attached to them. Attach this one in the agent step after adding sources.

add.title: Add source to “{{name}}”
add.description: Content is chunked, embedded and indexed after you add it
add.hint: PDF, DOCX, TXT, Markdown · up to {{max}} MB each
add.info: Uploaded files don’t sync. To update one, upload the new version — it replaces the old chunks.

delete.title: Delete “{{name}}”?
delete.description: This deletes the knowledge base. This cannot be undone.

new.title: New knowledge base
new.description: Give your knowledge base a name. You can add sources next.
new.nameInvalid: Enter a name up to {{count}} characters.
new.nameTaken: A knowledge base with this name already exists.
new.failed: Could not create the knowledge base. Try again.
